name: CREW Carbon
one_liner: Integrates CO2 mineralization into wastewater treatment plants, with offtake deals via Frontier from JPMorgan, Google, Autodesk and Stripe.

gov_grants: ~$6M of the round reported as grant/non-dilutive funding
pilots: Deployed at nearly 10 facilities across the US and Europe
signals.notes: Offtake agreements >$30M via Frontier (buyers incl. JPMorgan Chase, Google, Autodesk, Stripe). Sources conflict on HQ city (New Haven vs Brooklyn) and whether it is a Yale spinout -- not independently confirmed.
